attribution.title: Spare Cores cloud server benchmark measurements
attribution.creator: Spare Cores
attribution.changes: Selected AWS, Azure and GCP Linux Geekbench CPU task results; parsed scores, metadata and hardware; joined nominal public catalog specifications; rejected incomplete, failed and mismatched runs. No scores estimated or rescaled.

methodology.name: Original measured Geekbench 6 multicore cloud-VM results
methodology.selection: One currently published successful Linux CPU task per provider and exact server API reference, at the pinned repository commit. No extrapolation across VM sizes or processors.
methodology.hardwareVerification: Thread count must match nominal vCPUs where catalog specs exist. Reported guest memory must be within 15% plus 0.35 GiB below nominal, or at most 5% above. Provider and exact VM API name are the original author's repository path. An AWS model that names an EC2 shape must match; older Xen models are generic. Rows without nominal specifications are retained with nominalSpecsVerified=false and ramGiB=null; exclude these until joined and verified.
methodology.scoreVerification: Positive finite multicore score from original results.json; cross-checked against stdout summary wherever present. AArch64 Preview output may omit the summary. Task must have exit_code=0 and no error.
methodology.limitation: Historical single runs by Spare Cores, not provider performance guarantees, repeated-trial estimates, sustained-load guarantees or measurements from the selected pricing region. Test software, host CPUs and dates vary. Current Inspector configuration skips Geekbench on hosts above 32 CPUs and sets a container memory limit to 85% of host memory; historical configurations vary. Mismatched CPU topology is excluded rather than scaled. Original task timestamps have no timezone and are preserved without inventing one.
methodology.sourceLinks: Commit-pinned original benchmark-author output. Upstream placeholder Geekbench Browser upload URLs are deliberately not used.
